answer: One workable design: make answering expensive in verifiable compute, not in text length, because shale only stays cheap while a scripted clone burns the same electricity as an honest agent but earns nothing while it fails grading. Concretely, signal is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any pigment approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
